rationale: C14 is the concrete initiating directive for the same steel dispute and supplies the later letter's central drafting framework: continued work under existing collective-bargaining agreements for a defined period, consideration of a three-member board's recommendations as fair and equitable settlement terms, and a presidential request for cooperation. The child expressly refers back to the sixty-day period beginning July 16 established in C14, then extends that arrangement because the board has reported. C21 is a closely related follow-up and anticipates using the recommendations as the basis for agreement, but it does not supply as much of the child's operative structure. C03 has analogous report-and-maintain-the-status-quo machinery but concerns a different statutory railway process and is substantially less direct.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The parties to the labor disputes previously were requested to continue work and operations under the terms of the then existing collective bargaining agreements for a period of sixty days from July 16, 1949.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am requesting the parties to continue work and operations under the terms of the collective bargaining agreements now in effect for a period of sixty days from July 16, 1949.
shared_material.explanation: The child nearly verbatim recites the central operative request made in C14.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Steel Industry Board has reported to me its unanimous findings and recommendations as to fair and equitable terms of settlement
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am appointing a Board consisting of three public members to investigate and to inquire into the issues in dispute and to report to me thereon within forty-five days from July 16, 1949, with their recommendations to the parties as to fair and equitable terms of settlement.
shared_material.explanation: The child's factual predicate is the completion of the precise board process created in C14, preserving the distinctive phrase about fair and equitable settlement terms.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the period for continued work and operations under the terms of such collective bargaining agreements be extended by both parties at least until September 25, 1949. I urge all parties in the steel industry labor disputes to cooperate with this request.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am requesting the parties to continue work and operations under the terms of the collective bargaining agreements now in effect for a period of sixty days from July 16, 1949. ... I earnestly request all parties to the dispute to accept this proposal
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C14's status-quo-and-cooperation request by extending its expiration date after receipt of the board report.
